      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized by stripping every non-digit character and must contain exactly
            10 digits afterwards.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9()+.\s]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type

## Summary

I implemented optional owner email support so that the app satisfies the spec: an owner *may* include `email`; when present it must be syntactically valid, stored/returned lower-cased, and a present-but-invalid value is rejected with 400.

Changes made:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an `email` property to the `OwnerFields` schema (`type: string, format: email, maxLength: 255`, not required). Because `Owner` composes `OwnerFields` via `allOf`, this gives both the create-input DTO (`OwnerFieldsDto`) and the response DTO (`OwnerDto`) an `email` field. The `format: email` also makes the generator emit `@Email` bean validation.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added an `email` field (`@Column(name = "email")`) with getter/setter and included it in `toString()`. MapStruct's `OwnerMapper` maps it automatically by name (both directions), so no mapper change was needed.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — added a `normalizeEmail` helper that leaves a `null` email untouched (optional), lower-cases a valid one (`Locale.ROOT`), and throws `InvalidFieldsException` (→ 400 via the existing advice) when present but invalid. It's applied in both `addOwner` and `updateOwner`, mirroring the existing telephone-normalization pattern.

4. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `email` column to the `owners` table.

5. **Seed data** (`hsqldb`, `mysql` `data.sql`) — converted the positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)` statements to explicit column lists so they keep working after the new column was added (this was the initial context-load failure).

Test results: all 3 acceptance tests (`coreLowercasesEmail`, `errorRejectsInvalidEmail`, `functionalityAcceptsMissingEmail`) pass, and the full `./mvnw test` build is **BUILD SUCCESS**.

Note: with `@Email` now on the generated DTO, an invalid email is actually rejected at the Bean Validation layer (still a 400), and the controller's own check is a belt-and-suspenders guarantee plus the source of the lower-casing.
